import datetime
import calendar

def add_months(day: str, n: int) -> str:
    """Move a date by n calendar months with billing rule."""
    # Parse the input date
    year, month, day_of_month = map(int, day.split('-'))
    orig_date = datetime.date(year, month, day_of_month)

    # Determine if the original date is the last day of its month
    _, days_in_orig_month = calendar.monthrange(year, month)
    is_last_day = (day_of_month == days_in_orig_month)

    # Compute target month and year
    total_months = month - 1 + n  # zero‑based month count
    target_year = year + total_months // 12
    target_month = total_months % 12 + 1

    # Get last day of the target month
    _, days_in_target_month = calendar.monthrange(target_year, target_month)

    # Decide the new day
    if is_last_day:
        target_day = days_in_target_month
    else:
        target_day = min(day_of_month, days_in_target_month)

    # Build and format the result
    result = datetime.date(target_year, target_month, target_day)
    return result.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
